newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Atlas Copco says Q1 sales rose 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Copco says Q1 sales rose 6 pct.

text.p: Swedish engineering group Atlas Copco told its annual general meeting on Tuesday that first quarter sales rose six percent to 6.41 billion crowns, while its order intake increased eight percent to 7.22 billion crowns.
Foreign exchange rate fluctuations, mainly the strong dollar, had a positive impact and lifted earnings by about three percent, said chief executive Michael Treschow, who is stepping down.

Business area Compressor Technique increased its order intake to 3.31 billion crowns from 3.07 billion, while Construction and Mining Technique boosted its order intake to 1.74 billion crowns from 1.48 billion crowns.
Industrial Technique's order intake rose to 2.17 billion crowns from 2.14 billion crowns.
Atlas Copco is due to post its first quarter results on April 28.
